method: BLASTn 2.17.0+ vs UniVec; VecScreen-style score categories. Local reimplementation, not official FCS-adaptor output.
limits: UniVec includes biological sequences. Match strength alone is not proof of laboratory contamination. Whole-body microbes can have legitimate homologues. Review source entries, boundaries and library adapters before any removal; output capped at 100 reference targets per query.
